title: Cargohold selection

acceptance_criteria.description: Review and record the completed finite selection acceptance criteria from the existing whole-service plan.

evidence.command: Review final non-root image identity/binary and startup/idle SIGTERM smoke; full original Helm renders differ only in cargohold Deployment image, preserve Haskell default/test hook, fail closed on invalid targets; actual mixed Haskell/Go peers and bidirectional persisted-data switchback pass. Packaging inputs unchanged since render proof.

handoff: Optional local image and documented Helm post-renderer selection validated. Original Haskell defaults remain; no pushed image, production install or traffic switch.
